resources.string: You rent a small server on the internet — Hydra installs a VPN on it and connects it to your app. No technical knowledge needed.
• a rented server (VPS) with Debian or Ubuntu — from a few dollars a month;\n• from the hosting email: the server address (numbers like 203.0.113.5) and a password.
Your own server — what and why

A regular VPN is someone else's server shared by thousands of people. Your own server is yours alone: faster, blocked less often, and nobody else is connected to it.

How it works:
1. You rent a small computer on the internet (a VPS) from a hosting company — from a few dollars a month. Pick a country without restrictions and Debian or Ubuntu.
2. The hosting company emails you the server address (IP) and a password.
3. You enter them here. Hydra connects to the server, installs and sets everything up.
4. A ready connection appears in “Servers” — just tap “Connect”.

You never type anything into black windows. Hydra does not save the server password.
Choose what to put on your server. If unsure, keep the first option.
Your own VPN: all your devices\' traffic goes through your server in another country, and AmneziaWG protection keeps your provider from recognizing the VPN.
Recommended: the simplest way to your own VPN. Fits most people.
A workaround for hard blocking: traffic goes through services like Yandex Docs, so it is hard to block.
A ready-made website where you create users yourself and hand out links. Handy when several people need the VPN.
For those who want to manage users on a website.
These details came in the email from your hosting company after you rented the server. The password is never saved — it is used only during setup.
Four numbers separated by dots, for example 203.0.113.5
This does not look like a real address — check for extra characters.
The root user password from the email. Better to paste than to type.
Login key instead of password (for experts)
The oldest version. Works with any AmneziaWG app.
Intermediate version; works with old and new apps.
Modern protection against VPN detection. Works with Hydra and recent AmneziaWG apps.
The newest protection. Needs a recent AmneziaWG app (Hydra is fine).
Open the port in the server firewall
Needed only if the server has a firewall turned on (the check will tell). We never open anything without your consent.

We connected to the server. Every server has a “fingerprint” — like a passport number. Hydra remembers it and will connect only to a server with the same number in the future, so nobody can swap your server.
If you have just rented this server, simply tap “Yes, this is my server”. You may compare the fingerprint with your hosting panel (optional).
What we are going to do:
It takes 1–3 minutes. Everything installed can be removed with one button.
You cannot install while red items remain. Fix them and start again.
Installing. Do not close the app — usually takes 1–3 minutes.
The connection is already in “Servers”. Open it, choose “%1$s” and tap “Connect”.\n\nTo connect another phone or computer, tap “Add device” in the server card below.
The node is running and the connection link was added to “Servers”. Choose it and tap “Connect”. You can send the link to other devices — use “Show link” on the server card.
The panel is installed, the first user is created and added to “Servers” — just tap “Connect”.
Write down the panel login (to manage users on its website):
Password copied — paste it on the login page
The node is working. Its connection link is already in “Servers”; you can send it to another device too.
The panel is a website where you create users. Version %1$s.
“Remove from server” — Hydra signs in and removes everything it installed. “Remove from list” — the server keeps working, it just disappears from the app.
Each phone or computer needs its own access. Name the device, for example: moms-phone.
Name in Latin letters, no spaces
A user is one person or one device. You will get a connection link.
Device “%1$s” will stop connecting to this server.
To add a device, Hydra will connect to the server.
Remove server “%1$s” from the computer on the internet

Hydra will connect to %1$s and remove everything it installed: the service, settings and programs. The server itself stays rented at your hosting company — cancel it in the hosting panel if you want. Connections issued by this server will stop working.
The server itself keeps working, it just disappears from the app. You will no longer be able to manage it from here (add devices, remove it). Connections already added to “Servers” remain.
Enter the password of server %1$s (user %2$s). Hydra does not remember it.
This is the settings file for device “%1$s”. On this phone tap “Add to Servers”. On another device install Hydra or AmneziaWG and paste these settings (or open them as a file).
This is the connection link “%1$s”. On this phone tap “Add to Servers”. On another device paste it into Hydra: “Servers” → “Paste from clipboard”.
Do not show this to others: anyone with the link or file can use your server.
If a 3x-ui panel is already installed on your server, Hydra connects to it and can create users and hand out links. Nothing is installed.
On the server run: x-ui setting -getApiToken (or see XUI_API_TOKEN in /etc/x-ui/install-result.env)
The address starts with http:// - the token travels unencrypted. Connect while the VPN is on (Hydra traffic goes through the tunnel) or use https://.
"Remove from list" - the panel keeps working, it just disappears from the app. Hydra did not install this panel, so it will not delete it from the server.
